name: command-codex
description: Run OpenAI Codex CLI agentically via GitHub Actions and return results as a PR/comment.

codex.ubiquity:example: /codex add a unit test for src/foo.ts
codex.description: Run Codex CLI to implement a requested change (creates/updates a PR).

allowedAuthorAssociations.description: Allowed GitHub author_association values for the triggering comment.

denyForkPRs.description: If true, refuse to run when the comment is on a pull request from a fork.

requireExplicitInvocation.description: If true, refuse to run unless the comment explicitly contains `/codex` or `@ubiquityos codex`.

codexArgs.description: Extra args forwarded to `codex exec` by `openai/codex-action` (optional).

safetyStrategy.description: Hardening strategy for GitHub-hosted runners (passed to `openai/codex-action`).

passAuthTokenToCodex.description: If true, expose `inputs.authToken` to Codex as `GH_TOKEN` (enables `gh`/GitHub API access inside the agent).

commitMessage.description: Commit message to use for Codex changes.

testCommand.description: Optional test command to run after Codex edits (e.g. `bun test`).

maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Workflow timeout in minutes (best-effort; actual timeout also controlled by workflow).
